items.title: Einspruch deadline against interest assessment
items.quote: Sie können gegen diese Festsetzung innerhalb eines Monats Einspruch beim Finanzamt Beispielsoest erheben.
items.computation: Letter dated Thursday 19.11.2026; no separate 'Aufgabe zur Post' date is given, so the posting day is the document date, 19.11.2026. For a tax office (Finanzamt), delivery is deemed on the 4th day after posting (posted on/after 1 Jan 2025 → §122 Abs.2 Nr.1 AO): 19.11.2026 + 4 days = Monday 23.11.2026. That day is a working day (not Sat/Sun/holiday), so no shift of the delivery day is needed. The one-month Einspruch period (§355 Abs.1 AO) then runs from 23.11.2026 (day of delivery, not counted per §187 Abs.1 BGB) to the same-numbered day one month later: 23.12.2026 (Wednesday). 23.12.2026 is neither a Saturday, Sunday, nor a public holiday in NRW (24 Dec is a normal working day in Germany), so the deadline stays on 23.12.2026 per §108 Abs.3 AO.
